integrity: The displayed formulas are proved by two-to-one coordinate parameterizations and finite-field root counts. Exhaustive small-field computations are independent supplementary checks, not the universal proof. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Only unweighted loopless complete-graph evolution algebras; neither weighted graphs nor general expanders are classified. Equivalent unindexed literature is possible.
title: Quadratic splitting and exact idempotent census for complete-graph evolution algebras
